highlights: 50 acres at Lakshmanpura, 5 minutes from Thol Lake, among more than 10,000 existing trees
206 villa plots of 723 – 1,971 sq.yd super built-up in four zones: Winter, Spring, Summer and Monsoon
Villas: 3 BHK (type A, 343 sq.yd), 2 BHK (type B, 274 sq.yd), 1 BHK (type C, 191 sq.yd) and studio (type D, 146 sq.yd), super built-up
Club and sports: swimming pool, splash pool and kids’ sprinklers, gym, squash, badminton, tennis, basketball, box cricket and mini football
Café, restaurant, JOMO Cafe, hotel rooms, double-height and premium lounges, library, multimedia theatre, grocery and medical store
Party lawn, lake, lily pond, zen garden, yoga deck, bridge trail, jogging and cycling tracks, rock climbing and skating
Layout by R+R Architects · possession phase-wise
